text_block_list.text:
Something's been troubling Seiun Sky,
so one day
I decide to approach her
about it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure.
After training...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I know. I'll be right back
after I
change.

I wait for a few minutes, but she doesn't
show.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see, so she's playin' hooky again. Sorry,
but she
hasn't come back to the dorm
yet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The nerve of her to just break a promise
like that!
Should I grab her by the collar
and scream some
sense into her?!

After I finally manage to calm down the

overexcited Hishi Amazon...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What do we have here? Sky's trainer?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I understand. I'll help you search
for her.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I have something I want to
tell her
myself actually.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, I say search, but I already have an
idea of
where she might be.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? You do?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Obviously. Shouldn't you too, Trainer?

If she's not in her dorm, that means
there's only
one place she could be...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Not a single bite.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This is so boring.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Why's King with you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I also have something to discuss with
you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll just come right out and say it. You've
been
acting strange recently. Just...
weird!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You've always been irresponsible, but
you've had
a certain tenacious spirit
hidden behind all those
layers of
laziness.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now though? You merely lie about like a
deflated
balloon!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha, what a horrible thing to say.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This is what I mean! I hate it when you
give me
that stupid smile!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We know something's bothering you! So
tell us
what's going on!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Fine. I'll tell you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm sick of racing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So my enthusiasm disappeared—kapoof.
Is that a
good enough explanation for
you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
After coming this far... you still won't
quit it with
your horrible jokes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You think I would joke about this?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's a lie—you're not sick of racing. It's
just that
you're scared of losing, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So you're carelessly running away from
something
you have to face!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm not.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You are!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right now you're... you're so far below
first-rate!
It's super lame!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Listen...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You can say whatever you want, but at
the end of
the day, this has nothing to
do with you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...But it does!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because I... I... I got as far as I have from watching you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We're our generation's big three. That's
what
everyone called us, and it made me
proud every
time I heard it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But after the Kikuka Sho... I was no
longer part of
that group.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I was so ashamed... It was painful. I didn't
know
what to do.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And that's when you told me, "at your
final wrong
turn, you'll have found the
right path."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I never would have had that realization
on my
own.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's when I decided I would run down
my own
path—the path that makes me
shine the brightest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I found my path, and I'm finally ready to
face you
again, except...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now you're pulling this! Why are you
stopping
here?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Do you really not want to win anymore?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I've had enough... I misjudged you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So just stay there, wasting your days
away for the
rest of your life! I don't care
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If she misjudged me, well... that's her problem.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Leave me alone for a while... Please.

Her voice is so faint, it's like she's fading
away. I
can't bring myself to respond.
